purpose: Show the selected vehicle's physical state by merging security, vehicle-state and charging snapshots into a digital twin, summary and component details.
primaryGoal: Understand reported openings, windows, security, activity and lights without confusing unknown or retained measurements with current facts; inspect the twin and customize its browser-local paint.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selected-vehicle store/URL reconciliation and vehicle query
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, persisted selection and fleet fallback; the page does not introduce a local vehicle selector. The second useVehicles call shares the existing query key.

dataSources.owner: Vehicle current-state API and existing typed response mapper
dataSources.behavior: Enabled for positive vehicle IDs; forwards AbortSignal; live query policy; page requests 5000ms polling. as_of disables polling and selects a separate historical query key. Mapper retains observedAt, freshness and verifiedFields, which this page does not consume.
dataSources.backendLimits: Route registration is confirmed. Actual signal freshness, historical reconstruction, payload completeness and runtime response units were not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled for positive ID; forwards AbortSignal; page requests 5000ms polling; no as_of parameter in this hook. Supplies doors, windows, lock, sentry, seat and lights.
Enabled for positive ID; forwards AbortSignal; page requests 5000ms polling; no as_of parameter in this hook. Supplies charging activity and charge-port state. Typed charger_power_w is SI watts.
dataSources.backendLimits: No claim that every optional legacy alias is populated by the backend.

dataSources.behavior: Merges security before vehicle lock/sentry fallback; parses compound doors and enum windows/turn signals; preserves nullable component states. Charging precedes port inference. Activity booleans currently collapse absence to false; lastUpdated comes only from security.created_at.

Browser-local teslasync:vehicle:{id}:paint, inferred exterior color and fallback paint; same-tab listeners, broadcast and storage-event synchronization; reset or selecting inferred paint clears override. No server mutation.
Requests paint/model SIDE image, default size 1400; VehicleTwin falls back to SVG on image failure. No external request was made by this audit.

dataSources.behavior: Three independent live-provenance trust adapters and fatal-versus-refresh errors; six raw text/count metrics; existing date formatter. Operational metric/date adapter implementations were not exhaustively inspected.

Detail cards use one/md-two/2xl-four tracks: DigitalTwinPage.tsx:350.

Paint picker wraps outer groups, but its swatch row is a single flex row: VehiclePaintPicker.tsx:40,46.

issues.rule: MDC-043 / MDC-031 allocated-width and long-label preservation
issues.detail: columns defaults to 2 and KVList receives no responsive layout/wrap. KVList inline rows use flex justify-between without wrapping and the list uses grid-cols-2. Narrow cards and translated labels can crowd the two-column details even though the outer page stacks.
issues.fix: Use the existing KVList layout="responsive" or stacked/wrapping contract in TwinDetailPanel and verify all 19 rows at narrow allocated widths and 200% text; keep every value visible.
issues.confidence: high (source contract mismatch; actual overflow unverified)

responsive.verification: Unverified at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, container widths, RTL, long translations and 200% text. No rendered viewport test was performed.

sourceObserved: Localized overview label, Section IDs, decorative icon aria-hidden, named loading statuses, KVList dt/dd and text-paired badges are present.
Twin measures width and disables entry/driving motion when useMotionPreference.reduce is true.
Paint radios expose aria-checked and localized labels; selected glyph supplements color.

issues.rule: MDC-040 keyboard reachability and MDC-044 localization
issues.detail: InteractiveHotspot wraps a plain span with Tooltip, with no tabIndex or native focusable trigger. Tooltip documents the requirement for focusable children. Root role="img" may also flatten descendants. Its root aria-label, SVG title/desc and hotspot state/part labels are English literals (1527,1578-1579,255-271,572,801). Detail rows provide an alternative, but the advertised interactive scene is not equivalently operable from source.
issues.fix: Extend the existing VehicleTwin owner with localized scene name/description and localized inspection triggers or an equivalent keyboard inspection list; choose non-flattening group semantics when interactive. Reuse Tooltip and existing focus primitives, retain noninteractive image mode.
issues.confidence: high for missing focus/localization; assistive-technology outcome unverified

issues.rule: MDC-020 / MDC-040 radio keyboard and touch-target contract
issues.detail: Raw role=radio buttons are all in the default Tab sequence with no arrow-key/roving-tab implementation. Swatches are h-7 w-7 (28px); reset is a text-xs raw button without a target-size/focus contract. This falls below the design's 44px default target, although WCAG spacing exceptions require actual measurement.
issues.fix: Reuse existing radio/button primitives or implement the existing picker as a complete radio group: selected roving Tab stop, arrow/Home/End selection, visible focus and 44px hit area surrounding the unchanged paint swatch. Give reset shared Button behavior.

issues.detail: The page's summary localizes badgeStatus, but both StatusBadge instances render the raw status string, such as 'charging' or 'asleep'. Shared StatusBadge outputs label directly with no localized presentation-label prop.
issues.fix: Add an optional localized label to the existing StatusBadge while retaining status as the canonical FSM/style key and existing null placeholder. Pass the page's localized status text without recasing source data.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, screen reader, actual focus visibility/order, tooltip clipping, touch spacing, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced-motion runtime behavior are unverified.

states.loading: Fleet loading flows to PageLayout. Each detail card has its own 132px Skeleton. Combined summary loading stops when any source arrives; unrelated cards remain independent.
states.empty: No vehicle displays a dedicated fleet EmptyState. Three security-only detail cards show source-specific empty messages. Security/status merges three streams; unknown component fields display em dash. No add-vehicle navigation action is provided.
states.error: Independent detail QueryError retries and merged retry-all exist. fatalError is used rather than raw refresh errors, preserving retained payloads.
states.staleOffline: Three StaleRefreshWarning instances retain values and show paused/refresh failure notice and retry. Summary labels retained snapshots when any source is stale. No per-signal age/verified-field gating is applied to status or twin overlays.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026 unknown and retained are not current activity
issues.detail: badgeStatus calls deriveVehicleStatus(null), then falls back to offline with no data; any truthy security/charging payload promotes online even if retained. activityChip falls back to Parked (158-162) and security rows show No for isDriving/isCharging (181-182), while EMPTY_TWIN_STATE sets both false. A failed/no-source or old response can therefore describe a definite physical/activity state. useVehicleState already exposes trust metadata and deriveTrustedVehicleStatus, but the page discards them.
issues.fix: Use existing trusted state helpers and nullable status/activity presentation; retain source-specific snapshots visibly but distinguish unknown/stale/verified activity. Do not infer parked/offline/no merely from absent fields or source-object presence. Keep valid explicit false/zero distinct from unknown.

issues.detail: The page extracts only isLoading from useVehicles; when the fleet request initially fails, useSelectedVehicle resolves vehicle=null and the no-vehicle branch says 'No vehicles found. Add a vehicle' (254-261). Disabled downstream queries cannot recover this source. Fleet error is not a successful empty fleet.
issues.fix: Derive the fleet DataState and render the existing fatal QueryError/retry separately from resolved-empty fleet; keep retained fleet/selection on refresh failures.

issues.detail: All three sources are marked live and the page says latest vehicle signals. useVehicleState honors URL as_of and disables its poll, but the two latest hooks do not honor as_of and continue polling. A /digital-twin?as_of=... URL can combine a historical vehicle snapshot with present-day security/charging and call the merged twin real-time.
issues.fix: Explicitly preserve existing time-machine semantics and distinguish historical versus live contributions. Coordinate with existing hook/integration owners before adding any historical capability; either obtain supported same-instant snapshots or clearly separate unsupported live neighbors without mislabeling provenance. Do not invent backend support or a second range selector.
issues.confidence: high for hook/provenance mismatch; backend historical capabilities unverified

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-034 / MDC-042 restrained semantic scene
visualIssues.detail: ChargingUnderglow combines green blurred under-car ellipses and infinite opacity/scale loops (330-343). Body reflections also loop (628-645); additional glows/pulses are embedded in lighting/port/security layers. The root page has no neon/glow/fixed-white text matches, but this dependency supplies visible noise. Actual paint and realistic reflections are domain imagery, not blanket palette violations.
visualIssues.fix: Subdue or remove decorative underglow/reflection sweeps in the existing twin; retain physically meaningful light/turn/charging/door signals with quiet semantic accents and textual alternatives. Preserve genuine user-selected paint colors and photo/SVG fallback, rather than recoloring the car into a generic neutral silhouette.
visualIssues.confidence: high for source decoration; composed visual severity unverified

visualIssues.detail: Selected paint chrome uses border-white, scale-110 and shadow-cyan-500/20; focus ring uses fixed cyan/slate and reset uses fixed cyan text. Several text-xs/tracking classes bypass typography role wrappers. The white check glyph over dynamic paint is intentionally contrasted, not the same issue as fixed-white body text.
visualIssues.fix: Replace selection glow/scale and fixed white/slate chrome with existing control/border/focus semantic tokens and typography; retain the paint swatch's actual dynamic color and a measured contrasting selected check.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 icon hue should convey meaning
visualIssues.detail: Activity and all four component-heading icons use identical text-cyan-300 (also 353,364,375,387). These are decorative headings rather than source severity. They are not neon text, but repeat a saturated accent without differentiated meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/icon semantic color tokens for decorative headings; keep semantic Badge variants and data-bearing overlays meaningful.

architectureIssues.detail: isChargingActive accepts and reads charger_power_kw (193,198), while ChargingTelemetry exposes charger_power_w (api/types.ts:2197-2198). The page passes this typed charging object into buildTwinState. A positive canonical power measurement alone is ignored when charging_state and vehicle-state evidence are unavailable.
architectureIssues.fix: Update the existing adapter to consume canonical charger_power_w in watts, retaining >0 charging inference without kW conversion or dual-shape legacy fallback. Coordinate SI owner and focused adapter tests; preserve raw SI wire/cache values.

architectureIssues.detail: Merged lastUpdated is security.created_at only, even when vehicle/charging sources alone populate the twin or change later. The summary calls this singular 'Signal timestamp' (DigitalTwinPage.tsx:283-294); actual security/charging interfaces also expose ts. A single security timestamp cannot establish freshness of every overlay.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep per-source observed timestamps/trust in the existing merged-view contract or supply source-specific freshness separately to the summary; explicitly identify which source a timestamp describes. Do not fabricate a freshest timestamp or substitute fetch-success time for measurement time.

architectureIssues.detail: ambientLoop/ambientFrames only inspect matchMedia OS preference (46-54,62-64,84), but VehicleTwin's useMotionPreference returns OS OR low-bandwidth (useMotionPreference.ts:44-48). Root disables entry/wheel driving under low bandwidth, while scene loops still run when OS reduced motion is false.
architectureIssues.fix: Make the twin's ambient layers respect its already-derived reduce boolean through the existing helper/context contract; retain both OS and low-bandwidth policy and do not introduce a new motion engine. Verify default and reduced cases with focused owner tests.
